finding.title: Clip selection and highlights to the text viewport
finding.message: Selection and highlight backgrounds are rendered before the text viewport clip is installed. Since autoScroll now exposes the entire paragraph rather than a visible substring, selecting or highlighting horizontally scrolled text can paint outside the text viewport, including over icon areas.
finding.suggestion: Push the text viewport context before rendering highlights and selection, so their backgrounds are clipped along with the text.
finding.evidence:
tf.renderHighlights()
	tf.renderSelect()
	pc := &tf.Scene.Painter
	pc.PushContext(nil, render.NewBoundsRect(tf.textViewport(), tf.Styles.Border.Radius.Dots()))

fix.before:
tf.renderHighlights()
	tf.renderSelect()
	pc := &tf.Scene.Painter
	pc.PushContext(nil, render.NewBoundsRect(tf.textViewport(), tf.Styles.Border.Radius.Dots()))
fix.after:
pc := &tf.Scene.Painter
	pc.PushContext(nil, render.NewBoundsRect(tf.textViewport(), tf.Styles.Border.Radius.Dots()))
	tf.renderHighlights()
	tf.renderSelect()
